cases.note: the example; other trips are accepted too
four equal coats with R = 0: four trips
sizes exactly R apart do not stack
the largest R: every coat alone
with R = 999999999, only sizes 0 and 1000000000 can share a trip
the densest window is in the middle, after two isolated coats
a dense final group forces more trips after a long sparse prefix
seeded random distinct sizes mix gaps R and R + 1 with uneven trip lengths
seeded random sizes near the upper limit combine duplicates and exact-R boundaries
